issue.detail: The contract does not specify whether prev_in is updated during reset cycles. R4 says 'always' and edge posedge, but the reset field says first_released_cycle is 'cycle after reset deasserts at a posedge clk', which suggests prev_in might not track the reset cycle. This ambiguity changes whether a falling edge spanning the reset deassertion is captured. Two plausible semantics: (A) prev_in updates every posedge including reset cycles, so a 1-to-0 transition from the last reset cycle to the first non-reset cycle is captured. (B) prev_in is held or cleared during reset, so no capture occurs on the first non-reset cycle based on reset-cycle input. The R1 example uses semantics A, but the reset field text suggests B.
issue.spec_evidence: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
issue.alternative: Semantics B: prev_in does not update during reset cycles; the first non-reset cycle compares against the input from before reset or against 0, so no capture from the reset-cycle input.
